description: A React Native component for sharing and clipping content into notes within the Notesnook app. Handles loading shared data, previewing links, editing notes, attaching files, and managing clip modes.

classes.name: ShareView
classes.description: Main React component for sharing and clipping content into notes, managing UI, loading shared data, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: AppendNote
classes.description: Component displaying info about appending content to an existing note.

methods.name: showLinkPreview
methods.description: Fetches link preview data and updates note title and content accordingly.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads shared data, initializes note content, and handles different data types.

methods.name: onPress
methods.description: Handles saving the note, attaching files, and syncing data.

methods.name: changeMode
methods.description: Switches between clip modes (plain text, web clip, link) and updates content accordingly.

methods.name: onLoadEditor
methods.description: Marks the share extension as opened and loads data into editor.

methods.name: onRemoveFile
methods.description: Removes a file attachment from the rawFiles list.
